summary: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists Riley Ridge only as an unknown or undocumented site; no lookout history was found.

evidence.supports: Riley Ridge listed in Sublette County at 42.48826, -110.49804
The entry sits under the Unknown/Undocumented Sites heading
The list has a further group, relocated or replica lookouts, so it has more than three groups
A site moves to the lookout lists only if evidence shows regular fire-lookout use
evidence.quote: If evidence or documentation is uncovered showing that any of these were actually used as regular wildland fire lookout sites, they will be moved to the lookout lists.

notes_for_editor: One source only. The entry is a name, county and coordinates in the FFLA's Unknown/Undocumented Sites table, with no type, status, build date or staffing. Two web searches and the cached pages found no lookout at Riley Ridge, and a Wikipedia page for the ridge returned 404. The FFLA Wyoming list also has a standing lookout called Deadline Ridge in Sublette County (NHLR US 1520, WY 19) at 42.43799, -110.50456, about 5 to 6 km south of this point. A human should check whether this entry is a separate site, a mislocated Deadline Ridge, or a place name only, and whether it belongs on the map. The story is at the thin end of the length range because the sources say little.
